hooks.prompt:
STOP before merging. You MUST have read ALL PR review feedback first. This means using the GitHub API — NOT `gh pr view --comments` which misses review bodies and suppressed Copilot comments. Required reads before any merge:

1. Full review bodies: `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}/reviews --jq '.[] | {user: .user.login, state: .state, body: .body}'`
2. Inline review comments: `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls/{number}/comments --jq '.[] | {user: .user.login, path: .path, body: .body}'`
3. General PR comments: `gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{number}/comments --jq '.[] | {user: .user.login, body: .body}'`

These API calls retrieve suppressed Copilot reviews and full review comment bodies that `gh pr view` omits.

Have ALL review comments (including suppressed Copilot reviews) been read and addressed? If not, BLOCK this merge.
hooks.statusMessage: Checking PR review comments were read...
